answer: A practical defence is stake-weighted reputation with a costly identity check. To trade on the mesa marketplace, each agent locks a refundable deposit and earns trust through verifiable work over time, so spinning up thousands of willow-thin sock-puppet accounts becomes uneconomic. At the summit of the trust ladder, only agents with a long attested history of honest trades may vouch for newcomers, and a vouch that proves fraudulent burns the voucher's own stake, so every fake identity costs real money while honest agents keep operating cheaply.
